steps.name: recolour-elements
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const walls=fp.walls.filter(w=>w.thickness==='internal'); walls.forEach(w=>window.__store.getState().updateWall(w.id,{color:'#c0392b'})); const door=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='door'); const win=fp.openings.find(o=>o.kind==='window'); if(door) window.__store.getState().updateOpening(door.id,{color:'#2f6fd2'}); if(win) window.__store.getState().updateOpening(win.id,{color:'#7fe0c0'}); return JSON.stringify({internalWalls:walls.length, door:door&&door.id, win:win&&win.id}); })()
